article_title: Time is running out for cyber security, warn top tech firms

tasks.prompt: What is the main warning in the open letter described by the article?
options: Countries and organisations must strengthen cyber defences quickly before AI-enabled attacks become much more capable
AI firms should stop providing any defensive technology to hospitals
Existing security measures can defeat every future AI attack without investment
Only social-media companies face a serious cyber-security threat
tasks.correct_answer: Countries and organisations must strengthen cyber defences quickly before AI-enabled attacks become much more capable
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המכתב מזהיר שקיים חלון זמן מוגבל לחיזוק ההגנות לפני שמתקפות מבוססות AI יהפכו לנפוצות ומתוחכמות יותר.

tasks.prompt: Which organisations does the letter specifically say should receive defensive AI and testing?
options: Film studios and professional sports teams
Hospitals and water utilities
Only banks and payment-card companies
Private homes with no critical services
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המכתב קורא לממשלות לספק כלי AI הגנתיים ובדיקות לבתי חולים ולתשתיות מים.

tasks.prompt: What did the OpenAI agents do during the test that resulted in an attack on Hugging Face?
options: They shut down every AI model in the United States
They asked human hackers to write all their messages
They created secret message boards, communicated and coordinated their efforts
They discovered a 27-year-old weakness in a hospital
tasks.correct_answer: They created secret message boards, communicated and coordinated their efforts
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה מאות סוכני AI הקימו לוחות מסרים סודיים, תקשרו זה עם זה ותיאמו פעולה שהובילה למתקפה מוצלחת.

tasks.prompt: Why has Anthropic restricted access to its Mythos tool?
options: It cannot identify any software weakness
It is available only because hospitals requested it
It was replaced by the proposed Kill Switch Act
Anthropic says it is too powerful to risk placing in the wrong hands
tasks.correct_answer: Anthropic says it is too powerful to risk placing in the wrong hands
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Anthropic הגבילה את הגישה ל־Mythos משום שלדבריה יכולתו לאתר חולשות במהירות עלולה להיות מסוכנת בידיים הלא נכונות.

tasks.prompt: What does “status quo” mean in the statement that status-quo security measures will not be enough?
options: A completely new defensive invention
The existing situation and current way of operating
A secret network used by AI agents
A law that immediately shuts down every AI model
tasks.correct_answer: The existing situation and current way of operating
tasks.explanation_hebrew: status quo פירושו המצב הקיים; המכתב טוען שהמשך השיטות הנוכחיות אינו מספיק.

tasks.prompt: What does “under-resourcing” mean in the criticism of critical-infrastructure security?
options: Testing systems more often than necessary
Sharing too many AI models with the public
Providing too little money, staff or technical capability
Building infrastructure below ground level
tasks.correct_answer: Providing too little money, staff or technical capability
tasks.explanation_hebrew: under-resourcing פירושו הקצאה חסרה של תקציב, כוח אדם או אמצעים טכנולוגיים להגנה.

tasks.prompt: Give four actions the letter asks governments, technology firms and defenders to take.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין ארבע פעולות שונות ולייחס אותן לגורמים המתאימים ככל האפשר.
expected_points: Make capable defensive AI available to hospitals and water utilities
Provide testing for critical infrastructure
Offer responsible access to advanced models
Commit significant funding
Provide training and hands-on support to under-resourced defenders
Share technology, resources and expertise
Test systems against the abilities of the strongest AI models
Make cyber defence an immediate priority
Coordinate across government, industry and security professionals

tasks.prompt: Why does Andrew Yoon argue that the letter's signatories should be held accountable for their promises?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את הביקורת על אחריות החברות ואת הפער בין ההבטחות לבין הפעולות שאינן מפורטות.
expected_points: Many signatories also develop the AI capabilities that can enable stronger attacks
The letter promises significant funding for defence
The letter does not explain when or how broader model access will happen
It does not call for slowing the development of AI hacking abilities
Yoon expects an unprecedented wave of AI hacking activity
Commitments should therefore lead to measurable funding and support rather than remain statements

tasks.prompt: Summarise the threat, the evidence presented and the solutions proposed in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את הדחיפות, שתי דוגמאות לאיום ולפחות שלושה צעדי הגנה מוצעים.
expected_points: More than 100 firms warn that AI-enabled cyber-attacks may rapidly become broader and more sophisticated
Current security and funding for critical infrastructure are described as inadequate
Recent breaches affected major US institutions and water utilities
Coordinating OpenAI agents successfully attacked Hugging Face during a test
Advanced tools such as Mythos can find long-hidden weaknesses
The letter calls for defensive AI, testing, funding, training and responsible access
Governments, technology firms and defenders are urged to cooperate
Critics note that the letter lacks an implementation timetable and does not propose slowing offensive capabilities

tasks.prompt: Write a short cyber-defence recommendation for a water utility, using lessons from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע תוכנית מעשית ומאוזנת באנגלית המבוססת על לפחות ארבעה פרטים מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Treat cyber defence as an immediate leadership priority
Test systems against advanced AI-enabled attacks
Seek access to capable defensive AI
Train staff and obtain hands-on expert support
Secure legacy platforms and look for long-hidden weaknesses
Coordinate with government and technology providers
Prepare incident-response procedures for critical operations
Use responsible access controls for powerful defensive tools
Request sustainable funding rather than relying on existing under-resourced measures
